observations.topic: Root sidebar vs newer indexed pages
observations.detail: The root API sidebar snapshot lists 27 Targeting and Fires interfaces, while newer official indexed pages expose at least Physical Assessment, Target List, and Target List Assignment in addition.
observations.handling: Keep these as observed active interfaces with verification_status=verified_recent_index_not_root_sidebar; do not assume the sidebar is exhaustive.

observations.detail: Recent official Change Assessment page marks Change Assessment deprecated and explicitly directs users to Physical Assessment.
observations.handling: Keep Change Assessment for legacy compatibility, mark lifecycle=deprecated, and use Physical Assessment for new semantic matching.

observations.detail: The same SDK id com.palantir.ontology.defense-types.targetAssessment has been observed under older display label Target Assessment and newer label Serviced Assessment, with materially different link schema.
observations.handling: Use Serviced Assessment as current display label; preserve Target Assessment as alias and record the old schema as version drift rather than merging it.

observations.detail: Current page display label is Munition Type while SDK id remains ...ammunitionType.
observations.handling: Use current display label Munition Type and preserve Ammunition Type as alias.

observations.topic: Target <-> Target Effect Solution link names
observations.detail: Recent Target and Target Effect Solution pages expose non-identical relation naming (generic Target Effect Solutions vs Selected/Proposed Target Effect Solutions).
observations.handling: Preserve page-local observations and resolve only after a true single-timestamp crawl or live fetchMetadata inspection.
